subject: Renewal billing closure — split invoicing & VAT evidence playbook
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Marin <sofia@lunarhealth.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Oct 2027 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal billing: end-of-term billing and VAT evidence needed

Hi Sofia —

Congrats on moving to the renewal stage. Before we issue the final invoices and apply the renewal credits, we need two quick pieces to ensure the invoices are routed correctly and VAT is handled without delays:

1) A copy of the PO you mentioned (PO number + billing contact).
2) Confirmation of the legal entity that will be invoiced (LunarHealth Ltd. / LunarHealth, Inc / both). If multiple entities are involved please confirm % allocation.
3) EU VAT ID for the entity that will be reverse-charged, plus a statement of tax residency if different from the VAT registration address.
4) Preferred payment rails (SEPA/ACH/wire) and remittance email for accounts reconciliation.

Operational note: our standard approach for these renewals when customers span EU/US entities is to issue two invoices:
- Redwood (EMEA) invoice net of VAT / reverse-charge (requires VAT ID)
- Redwood (US) invoice gross for any US-legal entity charges (no VAT)

If you want us to apply the outstanding trial credit against the US invoice or split pro rata across both, let me know.

I’ve copied Laura to confirm the exact invoice dates and Marcus on payments. If you can attach the PO and VAT IDs we’ll prepare a split invoice draft and send you a DocuSign amendment to sign so we can close this out on the 15th.

Thanks —
Grace
Grace O'Connor
Account Manager, Redwood Inference

Would you send the split invoice draft so procurement can confirm allocation?

Team —

Thanks Grace. I drafted a split invoice worksheet (invoice_draft_split_entities.xlsx) based on Sofia's 70/30 allocation and the outstanding credit balance. Key asks:

- Confirm the invoice date we want to lock (I recommend 2027-10-15 so collections fall in this month for recognition).
- Confirm whether to consume the $8,400 trial credit against the US invoice (does the customer want credit applied to US charges?)
- Confirm remit instructions for SEPA (we will include our Euro bank details) and wire instructions for US.

Also, for EU reverse-charge we need both the VAT ID and the PDF attestation. If they prefer, legal can accept a signed statement from finance on letterhead.

I’ll prepare the two invoices once you confirm allocation and the credit decision.

Laura

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Marin <sofia@lunarhealth.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Renewal billing: end-of-term billing and VAT evidence needed

Hi Sofia —

Perfect, thanks for the PO and the VAT ID. Below is the operational playbook we’ll follow so procurement and finance have a single source of truth:

1) Invoice split & dates
   - Invoice A (Redwood EMEA entity): 70% of renewal value; invoice date 2027-10-15; net of VAT (reverse-charge).
   - Invoice B (Redwood US entity): 30% of renewal value; invoice date 2027-10-15; no VAT.

2) Credits
   - We will apply the $8,400 trial credit to the US invoice unless you confirm otherwise by EOD tomorrow. Applying to US invoice reduces wire remittance amount and keeps EU invoice net for reverse-charge clarity.

3) VAT evidence required
   - Please attach the VAT attestation PDF or a signed letter from LunarHealth Ltd. confirming the VAT ID and that the purchaser is taxable in the EU.

4) Payment rails & remittance
   - EU invoice: SEPA to our Euro IBAN (will appear on the invoice). Please send remittance to finance@redwood.com after payment.
   - US invoice: wire to Redwood Inc. bank details; remittance to payments@redwood.com.

5) DocuSign amendment & timing
   - I’m sending a short amendment that reflects the split allocation and credit application. Signing the DocuSign will authorize us to issue separate invoices and apply the credit. Link: https://app.docusign.com/Env/Signing/12345-DocuSignAmendment (attached as DocuSign_Amendment_Link.txt).

Next steps for you: upload the VAT attestation and confirm the credit allocation (yes to US allocation is our default). If you confirm, we will issue both invoices on 2027-10-15 and share PDF copies to finance@lunarhealth.io.

Ben — please prepare a short note for collections referencing the split and the expected dates. Marcus — please flag the expected settlement timeline once invoices are uploaded. Vivek — the amendment is standard; no unusual legal terms but looping you for awareness.

Thanks,
Grace
